intro: Jobs similar to bakers are food production and kitchen roles with a steady routine. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are restaurant cooks (78% similar), Butchers and Meat Cutters (77%) and food cooking machine operators (77%). All need little formal schooling.
shared: These careers share early shifts, following recipes or specs exactly and checking quality by eye and taste. O*NET rates judgment and time management at 3 out of 5 for bakers, and quality control analysis at 2.88. Cooking, meat cutting and food machine work use the same skills. None of the 20 needs less preparation than baking, and 13 pay more than the $37,160 baker median.

faq.q: Which jobs like baker pay more?
faq.a: 13 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Mechanical insulation workers earn $58,340 (57% more), Carpet Installers $50,340 (35% more) and roasting, baking and drying machine operators $44,810 (21% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. All three need no more preparation.

faq.q: Is cooking similar to baking as a job?
faq.a: Very. Restaurant cooks are 78% similar to bakers, and institution and cafeteria cooks are 77% similar. Both earn about the same: restaurant cooks make $37,390 and cafeteria cooks $37,450, about 1% more than bakers, according to BLS May 2025 data.
